comment: espressif.esp-idf-web is the official ESP-IDF extension (formerly the
ESP-IDF: Espressif extension). It bundles CMake configuration, the
idf.py task list, build / flash / monitor, and menuconfig UI in a
sidebar. ms-vscode.cpptools and ms-vscode.cmake-tools are the base
tooling it relies on for code insight and CMake config.
